name: Solis Minerals Ltd.
summary: Solis Minerals Ltd. acquires, explores and develops mineral deposits, mainly copper but also gold, silver, iron and molybdenum. Its key properties, Ilo Norte and Ilo Este, are copper holdings in Southern Peru covering about 9,500 hectares. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Vancouver, it was Westminster Resources Ltd. until July 2021.
